dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your projects, agents, and services at a glance.
dashboard.noRuns: No agent runs yet. Create a requirement and start a pipeline.
dashboard.quickStartText: Describe an idea in one sentence. Aura creates the repository, requirements, specification, implementation, and pull request.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Each project maps to one Gitea repository for code and documents.
projects.name: Project name
projects.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Leave empty to derive it from the name.
projects.templatePythonWebHint: FastAPI + Jinja + pytest skeleton that agents can extend.
projects.templateBlankHint: Documentation layout only. Agents create the application.
projects.emptyHint: Create your first project to initialize a Gitea repository.
projects.noRequirements: No requirements yet. Add one to start the agent pipeline.
projects.knowledgeHint: Agents search these RAGFlow datasets. Select none to let them search every dataset.
projects.knowledgeEmpty: No datasets available. Create one in RAGFlow first.
projects.knowledgeUnavailable: RAGFlow is not configured. Set it up in Settings.

requirements.title: Requirement title
requirements.ideaPlaceholder: Describe the idea in your own words. Aura agents will refine it.
requirements.emptyHint: Add the first requirement. It is versioned in Git and in Aura.

requirement.noPipeline: No pipeline has run for this requirement.
requirement.deliveredHint: The pull request was merged. This requirement is complete; create a new requirement for follow-up work.
requirement.mergeConfirmText: This merges the agent-generated change into the default branch. Make sure you reviewed the diff and the verification report.
requirement.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this change is rejected.
requirement.awaitingMergeHint: The pipeline is paused. Review the pull request, CI status, and code review, then merge or reject.
requirement.artifactsEmpty: No artifacts yet. Run the pipeline to generate documents.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Role profiles that shape each Claude Code process.
agents.roleKeyHint: Stable identifier used by the pipeline, for example developer or sales.
agents.modelHint: Leave empty to use the global default or the Claude Code environment.
agents.allowedToolsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow the default tool set.
agents.envOverridesHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. Overrides the global model provider for this agent.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Reusable instructions that agents activate when a stage needs them.
skills.name: Skill name
skills.contentHint: Start with YAML front matter containing name and description.
skills.empty: No skills found. Add one under skills/ or ~/.claude/skills/.
skills.createHint: Create a skill to capture a repeatable way of working.
skills.readOnlyHint: Installed outside Aura; manage it with npx skills.
skills.externalHint: Skills installed by `npx skills` in ~/.claude/skills or .claude/skills are listed here and usable by agents, but are read-only in Aura.

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.subtitle: Tools and data sources injected into selected agents at run time.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.envHint: KEY=value, one per line. Secrets are masked in the UI.
mcp.createHint: Add an MCP server to extend agent capabilities.

runs.title: Agent runs
runs.subtitle: Every Claude Code process with its status, cost, and streamed events.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Global configuration for Aura. Environment values are read-only here.
settings.providerHint: Environment variables passed to every Claude Code process. Per-agent overrides win.
settings.modelPricesHint: USD per one million tokens. Configured prices override the cost reported by Claude Code for that model.
settings.modelPricesEmpty: No model prices configured. Costs fall back to the values reported by Claude Code.
settings.modelPricesUnit: Prices are in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Use the model name shown in agent runs.
settings.languageHint: Applied to the configured Gitea and RAGFlow accounts. Values from .env are initial defaults and remain editable.
settings.claudeBinHint: Command or absolute path used to spawn agents.
settings.defaultModelHint: Leave empty to inherit the Claude Code environment.
settings.giteaTokenHint: Write-only. Leave the masked value unchanged to keep it.
settings.ragflowAccountPasswordHint: Must match the password stored in RAGFlow. Changing it here does not change the RAGFlow account password; update it in the RAGFlow UI too.
settings.ragflowAccountHint: Changing the account requires re-running onboarding to create an API key for it.
settings.ragflowMcpUrlHint: Standalone RAGFlow MCP server (SSE), usually http://127.0.0.1:9382/sse.
settings.databaseAdminHint: The local pgweb container exposes table browsing and SQL queries at this URL. It is bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
settings.secretHint: Leave the masked value unchanged to keep the current secret.
settings.onboardingHint: Re-run the identity, SSH, and Git setup wizard.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.subtitle: RAGFlow datasets available to Aura agents.
knowledge.notConfiguredHint: Configure RAGFlow in Settings or run the setup wizard.
knowledge.datasetsHint: Datasets and documents indexed in RAGFlow.
knowledge.empty: No datasets yet. Create one in RAGFlow.
knowledge.name: Name

onboarding.title: Welcome to Aura
onboarding.subtitle: Connect your local identity to Gitea. Aura stays locked until this setup is complete.
onboarding.stepIdentityDesc: Create or update the Gitea account that owns your repositories.
onboarding.usernameHint: Defaults to your macOS/OS user. Keep this name stable to preserve repository ownership.
onboarding.passwordHint: The Gitea password is the value of AURA_GITEA_PASSWORD in .env.
onboarding.stepSshDesc: Register a local public key so you can clone and push without a password.
onboarding.noSshKeys: No SSH public key found in ~/.ssh.
onboarding.sshGenerateHint: Generated keys have no passphrase for unattended local use. You can replace it with your own key.
onboarding.stepGitDesc: Match your commit identity with the Gitea primary email.
onboarding.gitMismatch: Does not match the Gitea primary email yet.
onboarding.stepRagflowDesc: Connect the local RAGFlow service and create or paste an API key.
onboarding.ragflowHint: Defaults to the local RAGFlow v1.0.0-rc2 API. Start it with make rag-up.
onboarding.ragflowAccountPasswordPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current password or reuse the Gitea password
onboarding.ragflowAccountHint: Aura registers this RAGFlow tenant account (or logs in if it exists) to create the API key. The password defaults to the Gitea password. Use the same account in the RAGFlow UI so your datasets are visible to Aura.
onboarding.ragflowPasswordConfigured: A RAGFlow account password is already configured.
onboarding.ragflowKeyOptional: Leave empty to create a key automatically
onboarding.ragflowKeyHint: Aura logs in as the configured RAGFlow account and creates a key. You can also paste a key created in the RAGFlow UI.
onboarding.stepFinishDesc: Review the setup and open Aura.
onboarding.allDone: Everything is configured. You can open Aura.
